sources.title: Thomson Reuters open-sources Thomson-1.0-Small, 35B MoE built on Qwen
sources.snippet: Thomson Reuters has put the open-weight member of its Thomson-1.0 family on HuggingFace: Thomson-1.0-Small, a Mixture-of-Experts model with 35B total parameters and 3B activated, a native context length of 262,144, and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B underneath.
